# Discovery parameters from the states of another variable, like the Home
# Assistant plugin: one matcher per state that sets them and shows the variable.
VARIABLE integration demo
  VARIABLE_STATE "Philips Hue" hue
    VARIABLE_STATE_SHOW host
    VARIABLE_STATE_SET mdns_types "_hue._tcp.local. _hap._tcp.local.|md=BSB002*"
  VARIABLE_STATE "Shelly" shelly
    VARIABLE_STATE_SHOW host ip_address
    VARIABLE_STATE_SET mdns_types "_shelly._tcp.local."
  VARIABLE_STATE "Acaia scale" acaia
    VARIABLE_STATE_SHOW address
    VARIABLE_STATE_SET ble_matchers "local_name=ACAIA*|manufacturer_id=16962"
  VARIABLE_STATE "No discovery" plain
    VARIABLE_STATE_SHOW host
    VARIABLE_STATE_SET mdns_types ""
  VARIABLE_STATE "Demo" demo
VARIABLE mdns_types ""
  VARIABLE_HIDDEN
VARIABLE ble_matchers ""
  VARIABLE_HIDDEN
VARIABLE host ""
  VARIABLE_DISCOVERY openc3/discovery/zeroconf_discovery.py ${mdns_types}
# Only Shelly shows ip_address, so Hue doesn't give it a matcher
VARIABLE ip_address ""
  VARIABLE_DISCOVERY openc3/discovery/zeroconf_discovery.py ${mdns_types}
VARIABLE address ""
  VARIABLE_DISCOVERY openc3/discovery/bluetooth_discovery.py ${ble_matchers}
